introHtml: No-minimum custom lip balm lets you order as few as a handful of units without facing typical bulk minimums. Whether you need branded lip balm for a small team, a one-time event, or product sampling before a larger run, our no-minimum program gives you the flexibility to start small. You get the same high-quality imprint and packaging options, with per-unit pricing that reflects the smaller quantity. No need to overcommit—just order what you need and see results.
